gm_notes.text: The player keeps their memories when things recur. Others may or may not. Let the player make and change things; what they change recurs too, slightly altered. Record made things with items.create.

The player can change a decision at any time and go back to the same moment or place any number of times; but going back reaches something that only seems the same, and changing a decision changes how what happens next is experienced more than what happens. Each turn of the loop poses a small decision, like a test, and the next loop differs according to what the player chose.
